usage: Neighbour is a noun used to describe a person living near you or in your community.
You can use neighbour to talk about people who live close to you in a friendly way.
Neighbour is often used to describe people in your neighbourhood or community, not just right next door.
You can use neighbour as either singular or plural depending on how many people you talk about.
Neighbour can be used by itself or with possessive words like my, your, or our to specify which neighbours.
